# VAMA Clinics

> VAMA Clinics (VAMA Advanced Hair & Skin Clinic) is an advanced hair, skin, aesthetic and wellness clinic with branches in Noida, Indirapuram (Ghaziabad), Lajpat Nagar (New Delhi), Lucknow, Agra and Kanpur. VAMA Clinics provides medically guided treatment options for hair loss, hair restoration, skin concerns, aesthetic treatments, weight management and allergy-related skin conditions.

## About VAMA Clinics

VAMA Clinics focuses on personalized hair, skin, aesthetic and wellness care with an emphasis on patient assessment, treatment planning, safety and natural-looking outcomes.

The clinic provides consultation and treatment options for hair loss, hair thinning, hair restoration, skin concerns, pigmentation, acne scars, ageing-related skin changes, unwanted hair, weight management, allergy-related skin conditions and selected aesthetic and wellness concerns. Consultations and treatments are available for both men and women.

## Laser Hair Reduction

VAMA Clinics provides laser hair reduction for unwanted hair. Treatment plans may vary according to treatment area, hair characteristics, skin type and individual response.

## Hair Transplant

Hair transplantation is a surgical hair-restoration procedure that moves suitable hair follicles from a donor area to areas affected by hair loss. VAMA Clinics provides consultation and treatment planning for suitable candidates.

## FUE Hair Transplant

FUE is a follicular-unit extraction technique in which individual follicular units are extracted from the donor area and transplanted into areas requiring restoration.

## Hair PRP

PRP treatment uses components derived from the patient's own blood and may be used in selected hair-loss treatment plans. Suitability and expected response depend on the cause and stage of hair loss.

## GFC Hair Treatment

GFC is a regenerative hair treatment approach used for selected hair-loss concerns. A consultation is recommended to determine whether the treatment is appropriate.

## Hair Replacement

Hair replacement solutions may be considered for individuals who are not suitable for or do not prefer surgical hair restoration.

## HydraFacial

HydraFacial-type treatments combine cleansing, exfoliation, extraction and hydration and may be recommended according to individual skin requirements.

## Face PRP

Face PRP may be used as part of selected skin-rejuvenation plans to support skin texture and address common signs of skin ageing.

## Acne and Acne Scars

VAMA Clinics provides consultation and treatment options for acne and acne scars. Treatment depends on acne severity, scar type, skin condition and individual factors.

## Botox and Fillers

Botox and dermal fillers are aesthetic treatments used for different cosmetic concerns. Treatment should be planned following professional assessment.
